bhajan.title: Bhaja Manuva Bhaja Manuva Govinda Narayana

discourse.excerpt: The natural is love, peace, truth, bliss. The artificial is hate, falsehood, war, grief, and greed.
discourse.theme: The natural is love, peace, truth and bliss; the artificial is hate, falsehood, war, grief and greed — return to what is natural.
discourse.title: The Natural and the Artificial

reflection: Swami restores the deep meanings: Truth never changes with time, dharma leads stage by stage toward liberation, peace is equanimity in success and failure, and love is seeing every being as a spark of Divinity. Today, practise one pillar deliberately — bear one setback with equanimity, or treat one stranger as a spark of the same Divine. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 3, 6 Dec 1963)
seva_nudge: Do one act of dharma today — give water to the thirsty, food to the hungry, or a patient hearing to someone upset — without expecting thanks.
